summary.text: Adam Withrow is running for U.S. Senate on the Unity Party line. A working father of four and educator, he previously appeared on the 2024 ballot for Colorado's 3rd Congressional District, and in his Ballotpedia survey says he is running because current officeholders are not serving the public well.

paragraphs.text: Adam Withrow was born in Algona, Iowa, and has worked as an educator, according to Ballotpedia. He describes himself as a working father of four, age 43 at the time of his survey response.

His campaign website says he has also worked as a ranch hand, certified nursing assistant, cook, contractor and detention officer, and that he studied philosophy, psychology and history in college but left early to pursue a business opportunity.

Withrow appeared on the November 2024 general election ballot for Colorado's 3rd Congressional District as a Unity Party candidate. In a 2023 Ballotpedia survey he described himself as "a normal working stiff from Southern Colorado."

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey response, Adam Withrow
